task_description: Write a method in Dafny to perform index wise addition of sequence elements in the given two nested sequences.
specification_response:
method IndexWiseAddSequences(seq1: seq<seq<int>>, seq2: seq<seq<int>>) returns (result: seq<seq<int>>)
Postconditions_prompt:
- The result sequence has the same length as the input sequences
- For each index i in the sequences, the resulting inner sequence at position i is the element-wise sum of the inner sequences at position i in seq1 and seq2
- Corresponding inner sequences in the result are of the same length as those in the input sequences at the same index
